title: The off-revision 'context only' marker in acceptance briefs applies to every verification record, not only those a bound criterion could cite
outcome: acceptance_brief_off_revision_marker marks a verification record from another source revision only where it matters: on a task that has a binding of the record's check_kind. Otherwise the wording is scoped so that it cannot be read as a general citation refusal, since an unbound criterion or a record of an unbound kind may still be admitted. The judged revision is also carried once: the brief builders read task.judged_revision rather than a separate source_fingerprint argument, so the two cannot diverge.
acceptance: A test shows an off-revision record of an unbound kind, or on an unbound task, is not marked as uncitable, while one of a bound kind still is.
The same-session brief's source_fingerprint line and its markers come from one judged-revision value; a test shows them agree.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
